briefing: Markets were modestly risk-on today with NASDAQ +1.1% and S&P 500 +0.6%. With 3 open slots and cash above the $500 threshold, we deployed into CBOE and PARR to diversify beyond our tech-heavy holdings while leaving one slot open for a stronger conviction setup.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Diversification means spreading investments across different sectors so that a downturn in one area doesn't sink the whole portfolio. Today we chose an exchange operator and an energy stock instead of adding more tech, since our portfolio was already concentrated in semiconductors and AI-related names.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 分散投資是指把資金分配到不同行業，避免單一板塊下跌拖垮整個投資組合。今天我們選擇了交易所營運商和能源股，而非再加碼科技股，因為投資組合已經在半導體和人工智能相關股票上較為集中。

market_education.summary_en: Broad equity indices posted modest gains today, with the NASDAQ outperforming the S&P 500, suggesting continued but measured risk appetite among investors. There was no major single catalyst driving the move, consistent with a steady grind-higher pattern typical of a maturing bull market. Breadth across the screened candidates was strong, with many stocks showing simultaneous bullish RSI, MACD, and moving-average signals.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤溫和上漲，納指升1.1%，標普500升0.6%，顯示市場風險偏好持續但幅度溫和。今天並無重大單一觸發因素，較符合牛市後段穩步向上的走勢。篩選出的候選股票中，多支同時出現RSI、MACD及均線的多重看漲訊號，反映市場廣度良好。

trades.reasoning: Bullish RSI/MACD/SMA-20 alignment and top score of 95 while diversifying away from the portfolio's heavy tech/semiconductor tilt into financial exchanges.
Strong momentum score of 95 with RSI, MACD crossover, and price above SMA-20 confirmed, adding energy sector exposure to reduce concentration risk.
